text:
alex: Heads-up — I want to propose an RBAC change for SIEM export consumers. Goal: reduce blast radius for raw exports and make long-term access timeboxed + KMS-gated. Planning to land this in the prod rollout next sprint, but need quick feedback.

alex: TL;DR: 1) introduce new role `siem_export_reader:forensics` with require-kms-unlock permission, 2) default external exports to 90d raw retention (tier to 2y anonymized), 3) add an oncall emergency unwrap flow.

tess: can you call out compliance impact? PCI/GDPR teams asked about 2y retention for investigations. switching to 90d for raw could be a blocker. :eyes:

raj: I like the KMS-unlock gating. question: will analysts need a separate KMS grant per tenant or one key with envelope encryption? also how do we audit unwraps?

alex: good Qs. plan is single customer-managed CMK per org when provided, otherwise orgs use a platform key with per-export key-wrapping metadata. unwraps are logged in CloudTrail + SIEM audit index and linked to export ticket id.

mike: during incidents, oncall needs quick access to unredacted logs. what's the expected latency for the unwrap workflow? we cannot add minutes.

alex: emergency flow: short-lived service token (15m) generated by ops-bot after 2FA + 1 manager approval, unwrap operation audited and auto-revoked. target end-to-end < 30s for automated flows, < 5m for human approval path.

tess: we should also add a migration plan for existing exported archives older than 90d. do we re-encrypt, truncate, or move to archive?

alex: suggested migration: 1) scan existing exports, 2) for anything >90d raw we re-wrap with archive-key and mark as access-restricted; 3) surface to customer contacts for consent where required. will draft a more formal runbook.

raj: can you paste the minimal IAM policy we want to add to the new role? that helps infra review.

alex: quick snippet (for review, will iterate):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "s3:GetObject", "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-exports/*" },
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/siem-export-key", "Condition": {"Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}} }
  ]
}
```

mike: that looks fine but IAM team will want a precise condition for the emergency flow. e.g., allow kms:Decrypt only when `aws:RequestTag/unwrap-request` == ticket-id and provided by ops-bot principal.

alex: noted. i'll add that condition and a TTL on the grant.

security-bot: Created ticket SECU-4928 and linked to https://redwood-internal/jira/SECU-4928

tess: can you add this to next Wed security sync? i'd like legal and compliance reps to attend before we ship.

alex: will do. draft doc here: https://redwood-internal/docs/security/siem-rbac-proposal — please leave inline comments. planning to announce to eng-sre and platform the week of the rollout.

raj: one more ask: include a small test harness that validates unwrap audit entries are immutable and tied to export ticket id. I can help write that.

alex: thanks — assigning you to the test harness in SECU-4928.

mike: ack, will brief oncall playbook updates after we lock the final API.

tess: ack — adding to calendar. :white_check_mark:
